item.text: I’ll read the new mail-stage contract and inspect the staged mbox, then adjust the importer and CLI to match its exact positional command and summary shape.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' MAIL.md && find inputs -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort && python3.12 - <<'PY'
import mailbox
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
p='inputs/archive.mbox'
box=mailbox.mbox(p, factory=BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse, create=False)
for i,m in enumerate(box,1):
 print('\\nMESSAGE',i)
 for h in ('Message-ID','In-Reply-To','References','From','To','Cc','Date','Subject'):
  print(h+':',m.get(h))
 body=m.get_body(preferencelist=('plain',)) if m.is_multipart() else m
 print('BODY:',repr(body.get_content()[:300]))
box.close()
PY"
